notes.title: Abuse of Steam Payment System Through Multiple Accounts Notice
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136017/d20b5135274b4652d041c0beba83a3981495ed29.png[/img]

Greetings from the <Summoners War: Chronicles> team.

We have confirmed that some Summoners are exploiting the Steam payment system by using multiple Steam accounts.

We will investigate all Summoners who play Chronicles via Steam and take disciplinary measures to restrict game access if confirmed to be exploiting the Steam payment system.
In addition, we plan to take the actions listed below to prevent any abuse using multiple Steam accounts.
Maintenance is scheduled to take on 03/28 (Tue), and we will inform you through an additional notice once the schedule is confirmed.

[b]▶ Measures for recently accessed Steam account and login methods (Hive Membership, Google, iOS, Facebook)[/b]
After the maintenance, linking multiple Steam accounts to a single login method will not be possible.
Also, linking to another Steam account will not be available after the maintenance.

[b]▶ Disciplinary measures for Steam accounts with refund history[/b]
Game access will be restricted if the recently logged-in Steam account at the time of login is confirmed to have engaged in abuse of the payment system.

Furthermore, we will take every precaution to prevent harm to the majority of Summoners who use Steam normally.
However, there is a risk that unintended login methods may be linked during the process of taking these measures.

If you are affected by this issue, please contact our 1:1 Customer Support Team to [b]get it changed once[/b].
We'll do our best to re-link the login method after confirming.

[u]* You need to proceed with the payment again to remove the game restriction status.
Please contact our 1:1 Customer Support Team for more information.[/u]

Thank you.

- US West: Mar. 5th 10pm (UTC-8)

- SEA: Mar. 6th 1pm (UTC+7)
[b]
▶ Details[/b]
- EU, SEA, and Japan regions will be added to Summoners War: Chronicles.

- If you've already played Chronicles, tap the globe button at the bottom right of the title screen to change the region.
- EU and Japan have 2 servers each, and SEA has 3 servers.
[h3][b][Server Names by Region][/b][/h3]
- EU: Liebli, Tilasha
- Japan: Nephthys, Tiana
- SEA: Ariel, Verdehile, Lupinus

[b]※ Precautions[/b]
- Character info is not synced between regions and servers. Changing the region will start the game with a new character from Lv. 1.
- You cannot transfer your Summoner data to a different region or server if you've already selected and played on a region and server."

---------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1][b]▌ Steam Mac Guide[/b][/h1]

[b]▶ Schedule[/b]
- US East: Mar. 6th 1am (UTC-5)
- US West: Mar. 5th 10pm (UTC-8)
- EU: Mar. 6th 7am (UTC+1)
- Japan: Mar. 6th 3pm (UTC+9)
- SEA: Mar. 6th 1pm (UTC+7)

- Mac users can now play Summoners War: Chronicles on Steam.
- Open Steam on Mac and search Summoners War: Chronicles to install and play the game.

[b]▶ Mac Minimum Requirements[/b]
- CPU: Intel x64
- RAM: 8GB
- GPU: Metal Capable GPU supported by Apple
- OS: Mac OS X 10.11 equivalent or higher
- Storage: 10GB


[b]※ Precautions[/b]
- The game will not run on Macs with lower specifications than the minimum requirements.
- At least 10GB of free space (HDD) is required to install.

We hope you enjoy your Chronicles adventure on global regions and Macs.

Thank you.
